title: A valid v1 create-contract authorization whose signature covers bytes it does not contain
pattern: The same v1 create, its auth entry still carrying SOROBAN_AUTHORIZED_FUNCTION_TYPE_CREATE_CONTRACT_HOST_FN, but signed over the CREATE_CONTRACT_V2_HOST_FN rendering (empty constructor arguments) the host hashes: the contract is created. A verifier that recomputes the payload from the entry's bytes rejects a signature core accepted. Under the bare flag profile (no EMIT_SOROBAN_TRANSACTION_META_EXT_V1) the same call writes Soroban meta extension v0, without the fee breakdown base writes in v1. By design since protocol 22 (one valid payload per action; github.com/orgs/stellar/discussions/1501). tools/auth-payload-check.mjs re-checks the signatures with hand-encoded preimages.

hazards.placement: a valid v1 create authorization: its signature covers the V2 rendering
SorobanTransactionMetaExt v0 under the bare flag profile (no EMIT_SOROBAN_TRANSACTION_META_EXT_V1), v1 under base

facts.says: The auth entry's root is the v1 create-contract function, for the kit Wasm.
Under the bare flag profile the Soroban meta extension is v0 (no fee breakdown).
Under the base profile it is v1, which carries the fee breakdown: here 43724 stroops of rent.
